name: Guide arm: 4, 7, then 1 Hz bilateral sine (Gateway Focus 21)
origin: This app's Gateway-style guides (our design; no published protocol)
summary: Experimental arm of the Gateway-style Focus-21 guide (our design, untested): in-phase sine on all temporal coils at 4 Hz for 9 min (Focus-10 and 12-style steps), 7 Hz for 4 min (Focus-15-style), then 1 Hz (deepening and open reception, 13 min), at 2 uT or less. The 1 Hz phase runs 10 min longer than its steps so that a paused guide (the helmet keeps running while the guide is paused) does not cut it short; the guide stops it after its last arm step, so it is off during the trial step. A pause still moves the frequency changes earlier than the steps they belong to. Run it blinded (real vs sham) from the guide. The Shakti safety page advises against real-time combination with binaural-beat devices.
source: Our design after the Gateway research notes; Lane et al. 1998, Physiol Behav 63:249; Shakti safety page https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/safety.htm
